snippet.title: Half-Life: Heart of Evil Source - Playthrough
snippet.description:
The very first Half-Life 2 mod playthrough on the channel.
This is one of the best ways to play Heart of Evil as it not only adds some extra scenes to take advantage of Source engine, but it also fixes the mod's notorious issues such as NPC pathfinding issue and ability to store notes so you don't need to take a screenshot of the notes.

Instead of playing that pile of garbage called "Napalm Edition", just play the original mod or Source port instead.

Download the mod here:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/heart-of-evil-source-port/downloads/heart-of-evil-source-update-101008
use this patch to play it on latest beta of source sdk base 2013: https://www.moddb.com/mods/heart-of-evil-source-port/downloads/heart-of-evil-source-patch-sdk-2013-20

Other mods I've used:
MTB's weapon reanimations: https://www.moddb.com/games/half-life/addons/heart-of-evil-revamped-reanimation-pack
